sources.title: Tamagotchi Paradise | Tamagotchi Wiki | Fandom
sources.snippet:
Tamagotchi Paradise is a comic book series in May 3rd, 2025 on Free Comic Book Day. The series teased and promoted the Tamagotchi Paradise before its announcement, introducing the backstory and general gameplay of the device through a Tamagotchi Lab researcher's perspective. The first episode was released both physically and online while further episodes were released exclusively online.

### It's a Manga of Tamagotchi! Paradise Edition[]

IAMOTPE Promo [...] The Tamagotchi Paradise has a color-screen, and the shell bears a visual resemblance to the Tamagotchi Pix in many ways, sharing a similar overall size and having printed graphics for the cracked-egg screen borders. The top half of the shell also has a cracked-egg design and is colored differently from the rest of the shell body; though, unlike the Pix, it can be flipped open and reveals a dock port for connection similar to the Tamagotchi Osutchi and Mesutchi. Unique to the Paradise is an [...] the Paradise is an antenna on the right side with a dial, which can be turned to zoom in and out on the device's screen. The dial features a clear window on the outside, a printed pattern of two arrows facing opposite directions inside. This clear window also serves as a button, where holding it down brings the user to Lab Mode; though, it also functions the same as the B button in some menus and games.
